'''Viyo Kobbeth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims|Pilgrim]] who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] illegally during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Viyo Kobbeth and his mother, [[Trea Kobbeth|Trea]] were among the many [[Pilgrims]] who followed [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] [[Kolovish]] to the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the aftermath of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Slaver/Legends|enslavement]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartels]]. Assisting in the establishment of [[Kalikori village]], Viyo was abducted by a [[Fashk|lone]] [[Flesh Raider]] in the [[Tythos Ridge]]. After being discovered by a young [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] in the Tythos Ridge, Kobbeth returned to his mother unscathed as the Flesh Raider simply wanted him as a translator.<ref name="TOR" />
